purpose: Separate substantive legal-source verification for the property-title pathway from technical fixture governance and live-record retrieval.
verification_scope: Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006

official_sources_checked_2026_09_23.role: official system description and Landdirect/Registry of Deeds routes
official copy/search procedures and distinction between Land Registry and Registry of Deeds evidence
historical source encountered during verification; not treated as current without further status analysis

verified_facts_from_sources: Tailte Éireann states that it maintains the Land Register, Registry of Deeds and Registry map.
Tailte Éireann states that Landdirect can be used to locate and identify folio information and access property-registration services.
Tailte Éireann distinguishes registered Land Registry records from Registry of Deeds records concerning unregistered property.
Tailte Éireann states that a Registry of Deeds search establishes the existence of relevant deeds/documents, while the legal effect requires examination of the deeds themselves.
The Irish Statute Book publication of S.I. 726/2021 is an official statutory-instrument source.
not_yet_verified: Complete current provision-by-provision status of all property-title provisions relied upon by the pathway.
All amendments and commencement provisions affecting the selected provisions.

Whether any historical rule encountered remains applicable to a specific historical transaction.
guardrails: This package does not claim live retrieval of any property.
Official-record availability does not by itself establish ownership, boundary or legal effect for a particular property.
Historical rules are not treated as current merely because an official copy remains accessible.
Technical validation does not substitute for legal-source verification.
